preconditions.description: The length of the source string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The length of the target string T is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^5.
The start and end indices ai and bi of the source substring are within the bounds of S.
The start and end indices ci and di of the target substring are within the bounds of T.

postconditions.description: The output for each query is '1' if the target string T[ci..di] can be obtained from the source string S[ai..bi] by applying the given transitions a finite number of times, and '0' otherwise.
